title: Swift: Fast Performance Tuning with GAN-Generated Configurations
problem: Manual system configuration tuning requires extensive expertise and exhaustive search over large configuration spaces. Traditional methods like grid search and random search are inefficient at discovering optimal performance settings across different hardware platforms and workloads.
motivation: Automating configuration discovery with machine learning can significantly accelerate performance optimization, reducing tuning time from hours to minutes while finding competitive or superior configurations.
method: Swift uses Generative Adversarial Networks to explore performance configuration spaces, where the generator network proposes candidate configurations and a discriminator evaluates their quality. The system iteratively refines generated configurations through adversarial training to efficiently navigate the configuration space without exhaustive evaluation.
key_novelty: Using GAN-based generative models to propose and explore system configurations for performance tuning instead of traditional search or optimization methods.
contributions: Swift system for automated configuration tuning using GANs
Novel generative approach to configuration space exploration
Demonstration of faster configuration discovery compared to baseline methods

metrics.speedup: tuning time reduction and performance improvement

limitations: Specific limitations not evident from title alone.
